card.name: Capsules after brand names; CJK in parentheses
card.fires_on: The word "capsules" (or "bag") right after a capitalized drug brand name, and the first characters of Chinese, Japanese or Russian text inside parentheses after an English term.

modes.label: Capsules after brand
modes.description: The word capsules or bag directly after an all-caps or brand drug name in label text.
modes.example: LIOZ<< capsules>> in adults is 20 mg one

modes.label: Foreign script in parentheses
modes.description: Opening characters of Chinese, Japanese or Russian glosses placed in parentheses beside an English name or term.

card.plain: It fires on the word capsules after a brand name, and on the start of a Chinese or Japanese gloss in brackets.
